## P2.2 BOM-first POS snapshot
Pancake remains the source of truth. Composite offers use `is_composite`, `composite_products` and the parent variation `remain_quantity`.

Priority: `PANCAKE_BOM` → `PANCAKE_DIRECT` → `FALLBACK_SKU_RULE`. Suffix rules are used only when Pancake has no BOM, and the row is marked `BOM_MISSING_FALLBACK`.

For composite offers, `PRICE_SKU` must be the exact parent composite SKU in Pancake. Warehouse selection is applied to the parent composite variation.

Workflow remains inactive until manual verification.

parameters.jsCode: const items=$input.all(),bad=items.map(x=>x.json||{}).filter(x=>['SHOP_ERROR','CONFIG_NOT_FOUND','RUN_LOCKED','PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND'].includes(String(x.SYNC_STATUS||''))||String(x.BOM_STATUS||'').startsWith('BOM_'));if(!bad.length)return items;const groups={};for(const x of bad){const k=String(x.SYNC_STATUS||'UNKNOWN');groups[k]=(groups[k]||0)+1}const alertText=['🚨 LANA / POS SNAPSHOT ERROR','Workflow: POS → Sheet + Redis','Errors: '+JSON.stringify(groups),'Examples: '+bad.slice(0,5).map(x=>[x.SHOP_ALIAS,x.PRODUCT_ID,x.SYNC_STATUS].filter(Boolean).join('/')).join(', '),'Time: '+new Date().toISOString()].join('\n');const token=String($env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN||''),chatId=String($env.TELEGRAM_ALERT_CHAT_ID||'');let telegram_alert_sent=false,telegram_alert_error='';if(token&&chatId){try{await this.helpers.httpRequest({method:'POST',url:'https://api.telegram.org/bot'+token+'/sendMessage',body:{chat_id:chatId,text:alertText,disable_web_page_preview:true},json:true,timeout:15000});telegram_alert_sent=true}catch(e){telegram_alert_error=String(e.message||e).slice(0,200)}}else telegram_alert_error='TELEGRAM_ENV_MISSING';return items.map(x=>({json:{...x.json,telegram_alert_sent,telegram_alert_error}}));

const e=$input.first().json||{};const alertText=['🚨 LANA / POS SNAPSHOT FATAL ERROR','Error: '+String(e.error?.message||e.message||e.description||'UNKNOWN').slice(0,500),'Execution: '+String($execution.id||''),'Time: '+new Date().toISOString()].join('\n');const token=String($env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN||''),chatId=String($env.TELEGRAM_ALERT_CHAT_ID||'');let telegram_alert_sent=false,telegram_alert_error='';if(token&&chatId){try{await this.helpers.httpRequest({method:'POST',url:'https://api.telegram.org/bot'+token+'/sendMessage',body:{chat_id:chatId,text:alertText,disable_web_page_preview:true},json:true,timeout:15000});telegram_alert_sent=true}catch(e){telegram_alert_error=String(e.message||e).slice(0,200)}}else telegram_alert_error='TELEGRAM_ENV_MISSING';return[];

const p=$('Prepare inventory batch update').first().json||{};
return[{json:{SNAPSHOT_KEY:'RUN_SUMMARY',SYNC_STATUS:'OK',ROWS_WRITTEN:p.row_count||0,TARGET_ROWS:p.target_rows||0,CONFIG_SOURCE:p.config_source||'UNKNOWN',SYNC_STATUS_COUNTS:p.sync_status_counts||{},SYNCED_AT:new Date().toISOString()}}];
